g.text: BFS: dequeue a vertex, then enqueue unseen neighbors
Source 0, target 3. Queue front is on the left. Edge weights do not change queue order.
Discover 1 and 2; set their predecessors to 0.
Discover 3 through 1; mark it before enqueueing.
1 and 3 are seen; skip both. Do not enqueue 3 twice.
Reverse 3 -> 1 -> 0 to return [0, 1, 3]. Vertex 4 remains unseen.
